answer: A Sybil-resistant identity can be anchored in signed smart-meter readings: each household's meter signs its kWh consumption with a utility-issued key, so one person cannot fake many homes. On the horizon of a month's readings, the quartz regularity of genuine usage stands out, and a pearl of a single tamper-evident interval proves a real residence; duplicate identities would need duplicate signed meters, which utilities issue only once per address.
